name: PrivacyBrew Android tracker signatures
notice: Contains information from the Exodus Privacy tracker database, which is made available here under the Open Database License (ODbL).
changes: Split signatures that had more than one package into separate entries.
Removed trailing dots from package prefixes.
Removed signatures that had no package prefix.
Mapped the Exodus categories to a smaller set of PrivacyBrew categories.
Added a small number of entries by hand where the Exodus data was out of date.
scope: The ODbL applies to this data table only. It does not apply to the PrivacyBrew app.
